sections.title: Updates
sections.hint: Check for new versions after startup

autoUpdate.toggleDescription: When enabled, OpenBitFun may prompt you shortly after launch if a newer version is available. Manual check from About is always available.

sections.title: Login
sections.hint: Start OpenBitFun when you sign in to this account

launchAtLogin.toggleDescription: Automatically start OpenBitFun after you log in. Exact behavior depends on your operating system.

sections.title: Power
sections.hint: Computer sleep behavior while OpenBitFun is running

preventSleep.toggleDescription: Keep the computer awake whenever OpenBitFun is running, whether or not a task is active. The display may still turn off, and explicit sleep or closing a laptop lid follows system policy.

messages.loadFailed: Failed to read the prevent-sleep setting
messages.saveFailed: Failed to update the prevent-sleep setting

sections.loggingHint: Log level and directory for this session

level.description: Controls log verbosity in real time. Changes apply immediately.

sensitiveDiagnostics.label: Include sensitive diagnostic data
sensitiveDiagnostics.description: Off by default. When enabled, local logs may include prompts, model request and response payloads, tool arguments, file paths, and webview event payloads for troubleshooting. OpenBitFun does not upload these log files automatically.

path.description: Directory where log files for this run are written.

diagnostics.label: Diagnostics Bundle
diagnostics.description: Export recent local logs, crash reports, and runtime metadata as a zip file. OpenBitFun does not upload it automatically.
diagnostics.confirmSensitive: The bundle will include sensitive diagnostic data and may contain prompts, model requests and responses, tool arguments, and file paths. Save it only to a trusted location and review it before sharing.
diagnostics.confirmStandard: The bundle may contain local paths, runtime details, and error information. Save it only to a trusted location and review it before sharing.

previousCrash.title: Previous session ended unexpectedly
previousCrash.description: Last session logs are available at {{path}}.

previousUncleanShutdown.title: Previous session did not record a normal shutdown
previousUncleanShutdown.description: Last session logs are available at {{path}}. This can happen after a restart, system shutdown, or development reload.

startupRecovery.title: Previous session ended unexpectedly
startupRecovery.message: OpenBitFun found a crash report from the previous session. You can export diagnostics if you want to report the issue.

configRecovery.title: Configuration recovered
configRecovery.message: OpenBitFun repaired or isolated {{count}} configuration issue(s) so the app could start. Review your model settings before continuing.

actions.openFolderTooltip: Open log folder in file explorer

controls.description: Default shell type for new terminals and for agent command execution in local workspaces.

panelPosition.label: Open terminal in
panelPosition.description: Where new terminal tabs open in a session
